name: (A.W.S.M C.O.C) All Weapons and Some Meds Craftable Over Configs
teaser: Configs for papershredder432's MoreHideoutCrafts mod, including crafting recipes for every firearm, and recipes for meds and med refills.
description_html:
Welcome to Meowlette’s crafting configs for Papershredder432’s MoreHideoutCrafts mod. It is REQUIRED for these configs to work!

These recipes are designed to help players who play more hardcore-oriented SPT, such as using Path To Tarkov, Realistically Equipped Traders, Softcore, Realism Mod, or other mods that limit your access to traders and make weapons and meds more difficult to obtain. However, they are more than suited for the every day player, acting as a way to eat up some of those junk items you have laying around, and a reason to keep more tools on hand.

Install is easy and included in the read me. Simply navigate to your user/mods/shredder-MoreHideoutCrafts/src folder, and drop the included configs folder in there! Feel free to choose to only use one or the other, or both!

WARNING! Your workbench, especially at Level 3, will take a minute or two to load all crafting options if using the Way More Weapons crafting config! This is normal and should not cause crashes, just let it do it’s thing for a bit.

  • Way More Weapons

  • Includes crafting recipes for EVERY Tarkov firearm (except for variants, such as the MP5SD, or the G36K, as they’re still an MP5 and G36, and I can’t change that) including upgrade recipes, such as turning an AK-74 into an AK-74N, an AKM into an AKMN, a DVL into an AXMC, a Rhino 50DS into a RSh-12, and many more! Almost every weapon has secondary recipes like this!

    I balanced these recipes the best I could, including requiring tools that scale with the loot rarity, lore rarity, power, and value of the weapons, as well as requiring intelligence items such as a Slim Diary, Folder with Intelligence, VPX, and others, to craft. This introduces what I call “sub-leveling” to the workbench, and introduces a reason to hold onto these items as well as progression to these crafts outside of just leveling the workbench up. Weapons such as a Makarov, TOZ-106, MP-18, or similar, do not require an intelligence item. However items such as the AXMC, MK18, M32, M203, GP-25, and FN40GL require high tier intell items and tools, being the Terragroup Blue Folder Materials, Propane, Welding Goggles, and Pipe Grip Wrenches.

  • Extra Meds

  • Introduces crafts for a large amount of meds not already craftable, as well as refill options for them (such as refilling the Grizzly medkit!) This helps hardcore players and early-game players keep stocked on meds when they have materials to spare, but not money, trader levels, or trader access in general.

I hope you enjoy the configs, and look forward to additional configs coming from me soon!

You can find me on Ko-Fi here!
